name: Jump For Poppy Playtime
desc:
Welcome!

✨ Jump up and grab Poppy Playtime Characters that spawn in the sky!
💸 Bring them back to your base to earn cash!
🔋 Upgrade your jump power to reach even higher blocks!
🏗️ Upgrade your base to unlock more slots and boost your earnings!

🎁 Discover rarities, collect them all, and build the ultimate Poppy playtime base!

Remember to 👍 Like & ⭐ Favorite the game for updates!
